title: Professional Lecture

nodes.speaker: Professor Kasey Remo
nodes.text: In the eyes of the pupil is... a pupil.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: In the eyes of the pupil is... a pupil.

nodes.speaker: Professor Kasey Remo
nodes.text: Indeed. But in life's lecture hall we're all pupils, even me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Indeed. But in life's lecture hall we're all pupils, even me.

nodes.speaker: Professor Kasey Remo
nodes.text: Oh any number of things. There is a complexity to determining what I should expend mental capacity on.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh any number of things. There is a complexity to determining what I should expend mental capacity on.

nodes.speaker: Professor Kasey Remo
nodes.text: Everyday it seems like there's something more I want to learn and less hours in which to learn it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Everyday it seems like there's something more I want to learn and less hours in which to learn it.

nodes.speaker: Professor Kasey Remo
nodes.text: Indeed. Thankfully strides are being made to increase the amount of information one person can digest in a lifetime.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Indeed. Thankfully strides are being made to increase the amount of information one person can digest in a lifetime.

nodes.speaker: Professor Kasey Remo
nodes.text: Mechanical repair.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Mechanical repair.

nodes.speaker: Professor Kasey Remo
nodes.text: HOVAs, trams, boats. I've spent my life studying and lecturing on history and the Nets and the advancement of networking technologies through the eras.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: HOVAs, trams, boats. I've spent my life studying and lecturing on history and the Nets and the advancement of networking technologies through the eras.

nodes.speaker: Professor Kasey Remo
nodes.text: I think, at this point, it would be fun to do something with my hands.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think, at this point, it would be fun to do something with my hands.

nodes.speaker: Professor Kasey Remo
nodes.text: I am, but that doesn't relegate my desire to learn in anyway. Ones profession is fluid. It can change at any moment and yet people remained fixated with the idea of arrival.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I am, but that doesn't relegate my desire to learn in anyway. Ones profession is fluid. It can change at any moment and yet people remained fixated with the idea of arrival.

nodes.speaker: Professor Kasey Remo
nodes.text: Once people reach a point they interpret as 'making it' they cease trying to expand their knowledge on topics that could provide a failsafe.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Once people reach a point they interpret as 'making it' they cease trying to expand their knowledge on topics that could provide a failsafe.

nodes.speaker: Professor Kasey Remo
nodes.text: Regardless, it's an interesting phenomenon to witness. From a sociological perspective of course.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Regardless, it's an interesting phenomenon to witness. From a sociological perspective of course.

nodes.speaker: Professor Kasey Remo
nodes.text: The ones on the screen or the ones who show up in person?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The ones on the screen or the ones who show up in person?

nodes.speaker: Professor Kasey Remo
nodes.text: What about them?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What about them?

nodes.speaker: Professor Kasey Remo
nodes.text: I've used it before and it was an interesting experience to say the least. Of course my students use it. You can always tell which ones too.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I've used it before and it was an interesting experience to say the least. Of course my students use it. You can always tell which ones too.

nodes.speaker: Professor Kasey Remo
nodes.text: Ehhh, they know the stuff but they don't... comprehend it? It's an interesting phenomenon, knowing something but not knowing how you know it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ehhh, they know the stuff but they don't... comprehend it? It's an interesting phenomenon, knowing something but not knowing how you know it.

nodes.speaker: Professor Kasey Remo
nodes.text: I don't know how to explain it. It's just... an interesting phenomenon, knowing something but not knowing how you know it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't know how to explain it. It's just... an interesting phenomenon, knowing something but not knowing how you know it.

nodes.speaker: Professor Kasey Remo
nodes.text: I suppose. That would be up to the people who use it and what they want to learn or experience.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I suppose. That would be up to the people who use it and what they want to learn or experience.

nodes.speaker: Professor Kasey Remo
nodes.text: An academic that doesn't question is nothing more than an administrator. Besides, judging by how much money the founders have made, there are plenty of people who believe "Level Up!" is worth it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: An academic that doesn't question is nothing more than an administrator. Besides, judging by how much money the founders have made, there are plenty of people who believe "Level Up!" is worth it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Guess I should have worn sunglasses.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Guess I should have worn sunglasses.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Guess I should have worn sunglasses.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Guess I should have worn sunglasses.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Huh?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I have a question about your students.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have a question about your students.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I have a question about your students.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I have a question about your students.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What's life teaching you right now?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's life teaching you right now?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What's life teaching you right now?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What's life teaching you right now?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: But aren't you a professor?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But aren't you a professor?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you use "Level Up!" ?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you use "Level Up!" ?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I hear that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I hear that.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you want to learn more than anything?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you want to learn more than anything?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What do you want to learn more than anything?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What do you want to learn more than anything?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Strides like "Level Up!" ?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Strides like "Level Up!" ?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Mechanical repair? Like HOVAs?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Mechanical repair? Like HOVAs?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You could use "Level Up!" to learn it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You could use "Level Up!" to learn it.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You could use "Level Up!" to learn it.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You could use "Level Up!" to learn it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Arrival?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Arrival?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: We should change that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We should change that.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: They've earned the ability to relax.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They've earned the ability to relax.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: They've earned the ability to relax.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: They've earned the ability to relax.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: "Level Up!" could solve it. Have you used it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: "Level Up!" could solve it. Have you used it?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: "Level Up!" could solve it. Have you used it?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: "Level Up!" could solve it. Have you used it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Both?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Both?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you know if they use "Level Up!" ?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you know if they use "Level Up!" ?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Do you know if they use "Level Up!" ?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Do you know if they use "Level Up!" ?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How can you tell?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How can you tell?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Interesting how?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Interesting how?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: But it's worth it, right? To gain more awareness? A higher understanding of something?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But it's worth it, right? To gain more awareness? A higher understanding of something?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: But it's worth it, right? To gain more awareness? A higher understanding of something?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: But it's worth it, right? To gain more awareness? A higher understanding of something?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thanks for your time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks for your time.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You don't sound sure.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You don't sound sure.
